title: Closeout summary: Enforce required gates during work and sprint closeout
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented runtime enforcement for required closeout gates on direct work close and agent finish close paths. Required gates now evaluate verification, checkpoint, review, and audit evidence; container work also refuses unresolved descendants and unresolved descendant gates. Added runtime and CLI regression coverage for missing review evidence, pending finish evidence, and sprint descendants. Validation: tsc passed; vitest runtime core/store/runtime-flow/cli passed 142 tests; sync refresh passed. Strict doctor and gate closeout still report pre-existing global warnings only: operation.volume, knowledge.raw_source_reconciliation, summary.legacy_closeout_coverage; gate sync/schema/docs checks were green.

Close reason: required closeout gates are enforced during work and sprint closeout with regression coverage
